name: section_visibility_application
description: Section visibility survives a DynamicColumns re-render.

scripts.build: npx quack build && npx quack copy

author: steven

ExampleApplication.Title: Section Visibility
ExampleApplication.Summary: A regression harness for solver-driven section and group visibility surviving a DynamicColumns re-render. Renaming a source row re-renders every dependent table; the hide class lives on an element that render regenerates, so it used to be silently dropped.
